specName: Release QA trusts a real fold on the Copilot app
request: Target path: specs/665-copilot-auto-fold-check (project root /Users/alfredoperez/dev/GitHub/speckit-companion.worktrees/fix-978-copilot-auto-fold). Source: #978. Fix the release-qa canvas harness check `canvas-auto-folds` in .claude/skills/release-qa/canvas-harness/checks.mjs: it reports a false FAIL. (1) Count only real command invocations of the plan/tasks commands, not file views/globs/searches of their SKILL.md or command files. (2) Judge the fold from the record's fold signature: plan and tasks start+complete boundaries written `by: extension` together (within a second). (3) Log the full detail of any offending tool call instead of cutting it at 60 chars. (4) Add a unit test for the false positive using the 2026-11-08 transcript shape (the model viewed .github/skills/speckit-companion-tasks/SKILL.md, the record holds the 4 fold boundaries within 3 ms, size simple) — it must PASS; plus a case where plan really ran and must FAIL.
expectations: #817 F3: a wandered session reads SKILL.md
